userData key overriding a detail object's LOD reveal distance — updateLod reads it as an absolute camera-to-anchor reach. Local-scale detail (the LEO satellite swarm, ISS-class orbiters) must not inherit the host's heliocentric orbit in the generic PAD + size·SCALE reach or Earth's near-field shell would render from halfway across the chart; these objects carry their own honest reach instead.
